title: Metadata create form: say "type a name" next to Name when the label cannot fill it
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

Filing gate: ② the optional half of #28180 that triage audit 6527260428 split out ("The optional Console prompt next to Name is a `ui/` change, outside this card. If it is wanted, it becomes its own p3 card"), carried to the seat by the #28180 card thread's `out_of_scope_findings` (os-dev-report 6529942225). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reach: a zh-CN or ja-JP administrator creating a permission set (or any metadata type whose create form derives `name` from the label) with a label written all in Chinese or Japanese. PR #28229 fixes the help text; the field itself still sits empty and required with nothing at the field saying why.

## Observed (on `main`)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/createDerive.ts`: `slugify` keeps only `[a-z0-9]`; an empty derivation clears the target, with the comment "Empty derivations … just clear the target; the UI then knows to prompt for manual entry". No Console surface issues that prompt.

## Wanted

- When the label is non-empty and its derivation is empty, the create form says so next to Name, in one short line (for example "This label can't be turned into a name; type one in snake_case"), translated in the shipped locales. It goes away once Name is typed. Test plus ablation.

Dedupe words: empty name derivation prompt, slugify CJK label prompt, createDerive manual entry, type a name hint.

Links back: #28180, PR #28229, triage 6527260428.
